meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
Safe Schools training will be differentiated based on district, state and federal guidelines.
The reconstitution of schools, if necessary, will comply with all applicable state and federal laws/rules/regulations.
According to state law, the first five (5) years of employment of all certified employees entering the employment of school district shall be deemed a period of probation during which period all appointments of teachers shall expire at the end of the school year.
Termination of probationary certified staff shall comply with applicable state law(s) at the time of termination.
Termination of a permanent certified employees shall comply with the applicable state law(s) at the time of termination.
